messages:
Samir Khatri: Starting POC handoff for Orion -> Redwood migration for Skylark Finance. Main asks: API adapter for response parity, prompt tokenization differences, and security checklist.

Jenna Alvarez: Quick ask from customer: they expect 'response_id' and 'billing.cost' fields in body like Orion. We use 'request_id' and separate metrics. Can we surface compatibility fields?

Owen Park: Yes, we can add an adapter that injects 'response_id' mapped from request_id and a 'billing' object with approximate cost when adapter=true. Small CPU cost ~5ms.

Rita Gomez: Security: Skylark needs SAML2, customer-managed KMS, and proof of SOC2. We have SAML and KMS options; SOC2 docs live in the compliance repo. Mutual-TLS for callbacks is a no today. Mark as blocker if they insist.

Samir Khatri: Plan: 1) build adapter branch orion-compat, 2) run 50 prompt parity tests and diff outputs, 3) run load test 30rps for 6h, 4) deliver pricing delta and contract language.

Jenna Alvarez: Pricing note: Skylark wants comparison for 30M tokens/month. I'll draft two SKUs: on-demand tokens and reserved monthly capacity. Include quantized model option for cost savings.

Owen Park: Also note: Orion tokenization treats emojis and ZWJ sequences differently, causing token count variance. Adapter will normalize NFKC and run Orbis-like tokenizer emulation. Need test vectors from customer.

Rita Gomez: Compliance follow-up: retention window requested is 60 days with purge logs. Ops can we confirm purge cadence and provide attestation?

infra-bot: deploy-preview: orion-compat started by Owen Park at 2025-02-12T11:08:12Z

Samir Khatri: Action items: Jenna send pricing by EOD, Owen land adapter preview and tests, Rita pull SOC2 and retention proof, Samir schedule sync Fri 9am. Blockers?

Jenna Alvarez: Blocker: need 12 representative prompts and a few streaming webhook examples. @Samir please request from Skylark eng.

Samir Khatri: Will request now (skylark-eng@skylarkfinance.com).
